name: Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport

## Overview

Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport (IATA: ATL, ICAO: KATL) is located approximately 11 kilometers south of downtown Atlanta, Georgia, in the southeastern United States. It consistently ranks among the busiest airports in the world by total passenger movements and has held that distinction for much of the past two decades. The airport traces its origins to the mid-1920s, when the site operated as Candler Field on land that had previously served as an automobile racetrack. Successive expansions transformed it into the sprawling facility it is today, functioning as the dominant aviation hub for the entire southeastern region of North America. Its position in the Eastern Time Zone (UTC−5 in winter, UTC−4 during daylight saving) and its central location on the eastern seaboard make it a natural connecting point between domestic markets and international destinations across multiple continents.

## Airlines

Delta Air Lines treats Hartsfield-Jackson as its primary global hub and maintains its corporate headquarters in the Atlanta area, meaning a substantial share of all departures here operate under the Delta banner or through its regional affiliate network. Southwest Airlines also sustains a meaningful presence, serving numerous domestic points. Beyond these dominant carriers, a range of international airlines connect Atlanta to destinations in Europe, Latin America, the Caribbean, Africa, the Middle East, and Asia, making the airport one of the few in the United States with meaningful nonstop reach to sub-Saharan Africa. Travelers connecting through Atlanta generally benefit from a broad spread of onward options, though specific schedules and carrier availability should always be confirmed directly with airlines or booking platforms.

## Terminals and transfers

The airport is organized around two main terminal buildings. The Domestic Terminal occupies the western landside area and serves as the primary check-in and arrivals hub for most passengers. The Maynard H. Jackson Jr. International Terminal, situated on the eastern side of the complex, handles international arrivals and departures and includes dedicated customs and immigration facilities. Seven concourses — labeled T and A through F — extend from these terminals and are connected by an underground automated people mover that runs continuously. Walking between concourses is also possible through underground corridors. Passengers connecting between domestic and international flights should allow adequate time to navigate the people mover system and, where applicable, clear customs and re-check baggage.

## Ground transport and trip planning

Atlanta's MARTA rail system provides a direct link between the airport and central Atlanta, with the Airport station located beneath the Domestic Terminal. This connection offers a practical alternative to road travel, particularly during peak traffic periods on the surrounding interstate network. Ride-hailing services, taxis, and hotel shuttles operate from designated ground transportation areas. Rental car facilities are accessible via a dedicated shuttle or walkway depending on the provider. The drive to downtown Atlanta typically takes between 20 and 40 minutes by road, though congestion on Interstate 85 and Interstate 285 can extend journey times considerably during morning and evening peaks.

## Practical planning notes

Given the airport's scale and the volume of connecting traffic it handles, passengers are generally advised to allow generous layover times when booking connections, particularly when transitioning between international and domestic flights that require customs clearance. The airport operates around the clock with no overnight curfew, so early-morning and late-night flights are common. Security wait times can vary significantly depending on the time of day and season. Travelers should verify terminal assignments and concourse locations before arriving, as these can differ by airline and route. The airport's official website is the most reliable source for current terminal maps, parking options, and facility updates.
